2: For the Chief Musician. To the tune of "The Lilies of the Covenant." A Psalm by Asaph. Hear us, Shepherd of Israel, you who lead Joseph like a flock, you who sit above the cherubim, shine forth.
3: Before Ephraim and Benjamin and Manasseh, stir up your might! Come to save us!
4: Turn us again, God. Cause your face to shine, and we will be saved.
5: Lord God of Hosts, How long will you be angry against the prayer of your people?
6: You have fed them with the bread of tears, and given them tears to drink in large measure.
7: You make us a source of contention to our neighbors. Our enemies laugh among themselves.
8: Turn us again, God of Hosts. Cause your face to shine, and we will be saved.
9: You brought a vine out of Egypt. You drove out the nations, and planted it.
10: You cleared the ground for it. It took deep root, and filled the land.
11: The mountains were covered with its shadow. Its boughs were like God's cedars.
12: It sent out its branches to the sea, Its shoots to the River.
13: Why have you broken down its walls, so that all those who pass by the way pluck it?
14: The boar out of the wood ravages it. The wild animals of the field feed on it.
15: Turn again, we beg you, God of Hosts. Look down from heaven, and see, and visit this vine,
16: the stock which your right hand planted, the branch that you made strong for yourself.
17: It's burned with fire. It's cut down. They perish at your rebuke.
18: Let your hand be on the man of your right hand, on the son of man whom you made strong for yourself.
19: So we will not turn away from you. Revive us, and we will call on your name.
20: Turn us again, Lord God of Hosts. Cause your face to shine, and we will be saved.
